WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.023093 38.909352)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

WITH pois_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Oyster Oyster'
    AND addr_city = 'Washington'
    AND addr_state = 'DC'
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Aspect(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast,
        (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM pois_geom),
        TRUE
      ),
      1
    ) AS aspect_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM pois_geom)
    )
)
SELECT
  degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_Extent(aspect_rast))), 1), ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(ST_Extent(aspect_rast))), 3))) AS bearing_degrees
FROM
  aspect_raster,
  LATERAL ST_DumpAsPolygons(aspect_rast) AS dump(rast, geom, val)
WHERE
  val > 0
ORDER BY
  ST_Area(geom) DESC
LIMIT 1;
